description: .jjunction/config.toml — the project manifest. Declarative and untrusted until `jjn trust` (see docs/design/config.md). Editors: a `#:schema` directive is stamped by `jjn init`.

machines.description:
Machine names this entry applies to (compared normalized, see
[`crate::config::normalize_machine`]); absent = every machine.

source.description: Real file or directory the link points to.

target.description: Link location, relative to the workspace root.

workspaces.description: jj workspace names this entry applies to; absent = every workspace.

LinkType.description: How an entry materializes on disk. Only `link` for now.

name.description: Explicit entry name; defaults to the url basename.

rev.description: Branch, tag, or full commit id; absent = follow the default branch.

target.description: Materialization path, relative to the workspace root.

SecondaryMode.description: How secondary jj workspaces materialize `[[repo]]` entries.

oneOf.description:
Symlink each secondary workspace's target to the default workspace's
checkout (one canonical clone shared by all workspaces).
Independent clone in the invoking workspace only.

secondary.description: How secondary jj workspaces see sub-repos.

AllowPolicy.description: How `jjn` deals with `direnv allow` for non-default workspaces.

oneOf.description:
Run `direnv allow <workspace>` when `.envrc` matches the default
workspace's copy byte for byte.
Print the `direnv allow` command without running it.

sync.description:
Files mirrored from the default workspace into every other workspace.
Defaults to the devenv/direnv set ([`crate::workspace::DEFAULT_SYNC_FILES`]).

title: jjunction local config
